name: Shakshuka
how: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce. Good with crusty bread.

name: Chickpea and spinach curry
how: Tinned chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes, spinach and curry paste. About twenty minutes.

name: Salmon traybake
how: Salmon fillets, new potatoes and green beans on one tray with lemon and olive oil.

name: Jollof rice with roast vegetables
how: A big pot lasts a few days. Add peppers and onions to the tray for extra veg.

name: Overnight oats
how: Oats, milk or yoghurt and some fruit in a jar the night before. Breakfast is ready.

name: Lentil soup
how: Red lentils, carrot, onion, cumin and stock. Blend or leave chunky.

name: Chicken and veg stir-fry
how: Strips of chicken, a bag of stir-fry veg, soy sauce, garlic and ginger, with rice or noodles.

name: Greek salad with pitta
how: Tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta, with warm pitta on the side.

name: Bean chilli
how: Kidney and black beans with tomatoes, peppers and spices. Freezes well.

name: Groundnut soup
how: Chicken or vegetables in a peanut, tomato and pepper broth. Warming and filling.

name: Baked sweet potato
how: Top with black beans, a spoon of yoghurt and some salsa.

name: Egg fried rice
how: Leftover rice, frozen peas, two eggs and spring onion. Ten minutes.

name: Tuna pasta salad
how: Pasta, tinned tuna, sweetcorn, cherry tomatoes and a little mayo or olive oil.

name: Veggie omelette
how: Eggs with whatever veg you have: peppers, mushrooms, spinach.

name: Red red
how: Ghanaian black-eyed bean stew in red palm oil, with fried plantain.

name: Hummus plate
how: Hummus, carrot and cucumber sticks, olives and pitta. No cooking.

name: Miso noodle soup
how: Miso paste in hot water with noodles, pak choi and a boiled egg.

name: Fish tacos
how: White fish with lime, cabbage slaw and a little yoghurt in soft tortillas.

name: Mushroom risotto
how: Slow and calming to stir. Finish with parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken and vegetable soup
how: Shredded chicken, carrots, celery and stock. Comfort in a bowl.

name: Yoghurt bowl
how: Greek yoghurt with berries, a few nuts and a little honey.

name: Pesto pasta with peas
how: Pasta, frozen peas and pesto, with spinach stirred in at the end.

name: Dal with rice
how: Yellow lentils cooked soft with turmeric, garlic and cumin.

name: Jacket potato with beans
how: A classic for a reason. Add a little cheese and a side salad.

name: Kontomire stew
how: A Ghanaian spinach or cocoyam-leaf stew with egusi or fish, served with boiled yam or plantain.

name: Prawn and courgette linguine
how: Garlic, chilli, prawns and courgette in olive oil, tossed through pasta.

name: Roast vegetable couscous
how: Roast peppers, courgette and red onion, stirred through couscous with herbs.

name: Avocado on toast with egg
how: Wholegrain toast, mashed avocado, a poached or boiled egg and chilli flakes.

name: Teriyaki tofu bowl
how: Crisp tofu with teriyaki sauce, rice, edamame and cucumber.

name: Peanut butter banana smoothie
how: Banana, a spoon of peanut butter, oats and milk. Quick and filling.
